Name: turning pierre into a moogle updated for 1.6
Author: mycatoreo
Description:
ever thought pierre was boring well not anymore.
 pierre has turned into a moogle.

now add the famous kupo nut as a tree.
you need 8 hearts with mog and 6 hearts with krobus then krobus will sell the nut.

the kupo nut finally works as intended.
krobus will sell the sapling on mondays 
and the tree will bear fruits only on sundays.
mog now has winter sprites thanks to raffiejohn
